name: Mariuccha's Lust
source:
Mariuccha, the biggest tycoon the world has ever seen, just died. No one knows why or how, but her domestic cat, Carmella Gattaladra, wants to investigate.

Little did she know, she'd meet some very bizarre individuals along the way.

[From [url=https://doubtful-but-lets-see.itch.io/mariucchas-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Mariuccha，世界上最大的大亨，刚刚去世。没有人知道原因或方式，但她的家猫卡梅拉·加塔拉德拉 (Carmella Gattaladra) 想要调查。

她不知道，一路上她会遇到一些非常奇怪的人。

[来自[url=https://doubtful-but-lets-see.itch.io/mariucchas-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
